response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.type, AVG(CASE WHEN b.spent IS NULL OR b.amount IS NULL OR b.amount = 0 THEN NULL WHEN b.spent = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE b.spent * 1.0 / b.amount END) AS rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.type), tp AS (SELECT type, AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM ev WHERE rate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY type) SELECT type, avg_rate, avg_rate / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) FROM tp) AS ratio_to_mean FROM tp
